text: Garrett Scholarship Program 2025-26, Garrett Scholarship Program 2025-26, for the following engineering branches: 1. Mechanical Engineering 2. Computer Science and Engineering 3. Electrical and Electronics Engineering 4. Electronics and Communication Engineering PFB the student selection criteria : 1. Scholarships shall be awarded to students enrolled in the second, third, and fourth years of their academic programs. 2. Students from the top 30 percent of the class, based on their cumulative academic scores from the previous year examinations, will be eligible for the scholarship. 3. The Sponsorship is limited to the top 5 deserving students per academic year. 4. Students belonging to families with an annual income of Rs. 5 Lakh or less. 5. Students who are not recipients of equivalent or significant scholarship schemes. Documents required from the college for shortlisted students - • CGPA results of the shortlisted students. • Income certificate • Form 16 and PAN card of the parents • Undertaking mentioning the annual family income. • Fee Structure for each batch (2nd, 3rd & 4th year) • Fee receipts of the students Garrett will sponsor a scholarship of up to 50K per student, or the actual academic fees- excluding tuition, library, laboratory, and other related academic fees- whichever is lower, for the relevant academic year, for the selected deserving students. www.garrettmotion.com
